Intro.Evnt.dialogue5: This is a world filled with demons and vast unexplored lands.
Intro.Evnt.dialogue6: The unknown holds a mysterious allure.
Intro.Evnt.dialogue7: And these mysteries attract extraordinary people...
Intro.Evnt.dialogue10: The day begins peacefully, rocked by sea breeze and singing cicadas.
Intro.Evnt.dialogue11: But as usual, Gon is already far away.
Intro.Evnt.dialogue12: Somewhere by the water, he’s chasing a goal of his own...
Intro.Evnt.dialogue13: While at the port, the day quietly carries on...
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue1:
Hey, Mito! We didn’t see you with the
little one this morning.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue3:
No... he left very early. He went to the
lagoon.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue4: Again? That's the third time this week.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue5: Is he still chasing that Pond Master?
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue7:
I told him I wouldn’t sign for the
Hunter Exam until he caught it.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue8: And do you think he can?
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue9:
Even the village adults never
succeeded in bringing that beast back.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue10:
I know... But he didn’t beg me. He just
looked me in the eyes... and said he’d
do it. He has that same look as Ging,
sometimes.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue12:
It’s not stubbornness. It’s... something
else.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue13:
Something I can’t take from him, even
if I wanted to.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue14:
So it seems the boy is about to take
flight.
PortIntro.IntroEvt.dialogue16:
But if he returns with that creature...
then yes. I’ll have no excuse to stop
him.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue1:
...He tugged on the line again, but not
enough to hook it. It's clever.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue2:
I know you're there... I feel your
presence underwater.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue3:
Mito said I had to catch you if I
wanted to leave... that it was my proof.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue4:
It's not just a fish. It’s a challenge.
Like the island itself said: “Show me
if you’re worthy.”
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue5:
Dad came through here too, right? He
had to face this... before becoming a
Hunter.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue6:
I want to know why he left. Why he
chose this... instead of staying.
Lagon.IntroLagon.dialogue7:
Maybe if I pass this trial... I’ll
understand a little better.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue1:
He... he did it... That kid actually did
it...
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue3:
Last time I saw that beast out of
water... was twenty years ago.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue5:
It was Ging. He brought it right here...
just like his son today.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue8: You have the same look he had.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue9:
It’s not just a catch. It’s a rite. A
passage.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue10:
All that’s missing is the wind to
carry it away.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue11: Go... become who you want to become.
PortCapture.EV001.dialogue12:
He's not a kid anymore. Not after
that.
MaisonMitoIntro.Envt.dialogue1:
You know, Mito... This reminds me of
something. Ging also caught the Pond
Master at twelve.
MaisonMitoIntro.Envt.dialogue2:
Yes, I remember... Same look in his
eyes.
MaisonMitoIntro.Envt.dialogue3:
Determination, impatience... and that
thirst for freedom.
MaisonMitoIntro.Envt.dialogue4:
And now it’s Gon. As if fate is
replaying the same scene...
MaisonMitoIntro.Envt.dialogue5:
The only difference is this time... my
heart isn’t ready to let him go
without a word.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue2:
I’m leaving tomorrow morning. I’ve
prepared everything.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue3: Gon... I need to tell you something.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue4:
Your father... Ging... He left you here to
become a Hunter.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue5:
He never tried to come back. No
letters. No visits.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue6: And yet... he became one of the best.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue10:
I can’t help thinking he abandoned
me.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue11:
I was just a baby. He could have
stayed...
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue12: I need to know the truth!
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue13: Staying there will not make me know anything about him.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue14:
Maybe by following in his steps,
I’ll finally understand who he is...
and who I am.
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue15:
Discovering unknown places,
meeting amazing people...
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue16:
If being a Hunter means living
like that, then I’ll become one
no matter what!
MaisonMitoEtageIntro.Envt.dialogue17:
You’re just like your father...
No one can stop you.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Envt.dialogue3:
Yes. You might need them. Not sure
if boats serve fresh fish daily.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Envt.dialogue7:
Then go. But don’t forget where
you come from.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Pecheur.dialogue3:
A port guy lost rare bait. He saved
it for the Sea Exam.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Pecheur.dialogue4:
An animal stole it and ran into the
coastal forest. We can't go now.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Pecheur.dialogue5:
Can you go? There’s a reward
waiting.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Pecheur.dialogue6:
Want to become a Hunter? Start
there.
IleBaleine-MitoHouse.Pecheur.dialogue8:
Find me at the port once you’ve
got it!
IleBaleine-Map1.EVT001.dialogue1:
Did you know freshwater catfish
sing when it storms?
IleBaleine-Map1.EVT001.dialogue2:
Well, maybe it’s in my head... but I
still listen.
IleBaleine-Map1.Envt.dialogue1:
Be careful now — forest animals
might attack you.
IleBaleine-Map1.Envt.dialogue2: Ahh there!! A boar is charging us!
IleBaleine-Map1.Envt.dialogue3:
Glad you were here! I’ll wait for
you at the Port.
Port.PecheurQuete.dialogue2: Yes! I got it. Here it is!
Port.PecheurQuete.dialogue3b:
I think the boat’s ready. It’s at the
northeast end of the port.
Port.PecheurQuete.dialogue6:
Try to do it quickly... We’re stuck
here without it...
Port.PecheurQuete.dialogue7: Ahhh thanks for finding that bait!
Port.EV005.dialogue1:
Hmmm... If you find this bait, you’ll
do more than help my friend...
Port.EV005.dialogue2:
You’ll bring hope back to the
entire port. Go on, kid.
Port.EV005.dialogue3:
You did it... Haha! I knew it! My
grumpy friend owes you a drink now!
Port.EV007.dialogue1:
Hehehe... The leaves speak... They told
me a legendary bait vanished... or was
it a banana?
Port.EV007.dialogue2:
Ah, whatever. Find it, boy. Or the
port will sink!
Port.EV007.dialogue3:
Heh... balance is restored... The
gorillas sing again, the worms dance,
and you...
Port.EV006.dialogue1:
Well! If you haven’t found the bait,
no one will bite. Not even me.
Port.EV006.dialogue2:
Well done, kid. With that bait,
I bet they’ll bite like crazy. I owe
you a line, haha!
Port.EV009.dialogue1:
I can’t rebuild while beasts still
roam.
Port.EV009.dialogue2:
And without the bait... fishermen
complain... same old routine.
Port.EV009.dialogue3:
Thanks, kid. Now the port can
breathe again.
Port.EV009.dialogue4:
If you need a raft or two, you know
where to find me.
Port.EV010.dialogue1:
I saw monkeys run off with something
shiny, all excited...
Port.EV010.dialogue2: I hope you’re not after that too.
Port.EV010.dialogue3:
You got it? Heh, I knew you had grit.
This port will talk about you for
a long time.
Port.Bateau.dialogue1:
The boat is ready to sail. Want to
board now?
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue1:
Hmm... another lost soul among the pines
and mist?
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue2:
Looking for a roof? An onigiri? Or just
a chat with an old tree like me?
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue5: I'd like to sleep a bit, please.
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue8:
Looks like you don't have enough
to pay for lodging, kid!
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue9: I'd like something to eat, please.
How many onigiri do you want?
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere2.EV002.dialogue1: Perfect, kid. Here's what you deserve...

Looks like you don't have enough
to pay for that, kid!
I just wanted to talk a little.

Silence is rare here, especially
these days.

The monkeys are restless. Not the
'playful' kind—more like 'plots in
the foliage.'

And if the foliage gorilla comes out
at this hour, it’s not to smell
the flowers.
IleBaleine-ForetCotiere3.EVT-Combat.dial: Ahh, looks like I found it!
All I have to do is bring the bait back!
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue2: I can't wait to take the Hunter Exam!
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue3:
Tss... A kid thinks he can pass
the exam?
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue5:
Many hopefuls end up going home...
or worse.
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue6:
You better enjoy yourself while
you still can.
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue7: I'll become a Hunter, no matter what.
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue8:
I may be young, but I'm ready.
And I came here to succeed.
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue11:
Captain! A storm’s coming!
From the northeast!
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue12:
Hahaha, now he's forecasting
the weather?
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue13:
You saw a cloud and panicked,
right?
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue16:
(...I've seen it before, long ago.
Can’t recall when... or where.)
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue17:
You’ve got sharp eyes, kid.
And sharp senses too.
BateauPont.Evnt.dialogue18:
Alright, everyone on deck!
We’ve got to maneuver before
the sea really wakes up.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue2:
Looks like we’re entering
a rocky zone.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue3:
We’ll have to be careful not
to rip the hull.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue4:
Avoid waves and rocks until
the storm calms down.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue5:
The sea is testing us...
Stay the course no matter what.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue7:
Be one with the ship, not
against it.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue8:
Don’t trust the sudden calm—
that’s when it hits hardest.
Mer.Evnt.dialogue9:
You’ve got good reflexes...
Done this before?
Mer.Evnt.dialogue10:
Hold on! The sky's clearing...
we’re almost through.
BateauCalle.Evnt.dialogue2:
Can’t even stand upright
in a simple swell.
BateauCalle.Evnt.dialogue3:
(Damn... Not one of these
candidates looks used to a boat.)
BateauCalle.Evnt.dialogue7:
Gather those three.
Let’s have a talk.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue6:
Why do you want to become
Hunters?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue7:
And why should you care?
You’re not the jury.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue13:
My father’s a Hunter.
The job fascinates me.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue14:
I want to know why he
abandoned me.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue15:
They say Hunters make good money...
so why not.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue19:
Tell me... your father...
Is he Ging, by any chance?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue24:
Hey, boy! Who asked
you to talk, huh?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue25:
Meh... I don’t mind.
No reason to hide why I'm here.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue27: And what if I don’t want to, huh?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue29:
Tch, I’m older than you.
Show respect—call me *Mr.* Leorio.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue30:
I don’t want to lie.
So I’d rather say nothing, Captain.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue33:
But telling the truth...
would say too much.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue35:
I’m sorry, but I won’t
say more.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue36: You gonna listen to me or what?!
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue37:
So... both of you refuse
to answer?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue38:
Katso! Tell the committee we’ve
got two more rejects.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue43:
There are hundreds of applicants.
The committee can't test them all.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue44:
So they use people like me
to filter right from the start.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue45:
At sea, I watch. I take notes.
And I decide who moves on.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue46:
Before we even arrived,
I had already sent the report:
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue47:
Everyone else is eliminated...
except you three.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue48:
If you can't handle rough seas,
forget becoming a Hunter.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue53: I'm the last of the Kurta clan.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue54:
Four years ago,
the Phantom Troupe killed my people.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue55:
I want to become a Hunter
to find them. And kill them.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue56: You want to be a bounty hunter, huh?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue57:
The Troupe is Class A.
You're risking your life, kid.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue60: Losing the rage that drives me.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue62: But why become a Hunter for that?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue63:
That's the dumbest question
you could ask, Leorio.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue65:
Hunters get access to areas,
archives, leads you can't even imagine.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue66:
But that probably escaped you,
with your birdbrain.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue68:
Easy! Mister Leorio,
why do you want to be a Hunter?
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue70:
Big house, fancy car,
party life. That’s it.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue71: But it won't buy you dignity.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue74:
I'll end the Kurta story
here and now!
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue78: You two! I'm not done yet!
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue81:
If you really want to understand
someone, let them get mad.
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue86:
Hard starboard, now!
We won’t face it head-on!
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue87:
Katso! Grab four buckets
and get up on deck!
BateauCabine.Evnt.dialogue88:
Seal the hatches, secure the cargo,
and fasten the sails!
BateauPontAprés.Evnt.dialogue1:
Come on guys, hurry up!
We’re not gonna stand around all day!
BateauPontAprés.Evnt.dialogue4:
Take back what you said right now!
If you do, I might forgive you!
BateauPontAprés.Evnt.dialogue5:
I’m older than you, remember!
So you should apologize first!
BateauPontAprés.Evnt.dialogue6:
Or we can settle this another way
if you’d prefer!
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue2: Maybe, but you caught me, right?
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue3: That’s what matters! You both saved me!
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue4: I guess you could see it that way...
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue7:
Thank you so much, it’s thanks to you
I’m still here.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue8:
Oh, I didn’t do much.
They’re the ones who pulled us back aboard.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue9: I truly thank you from the bottom of my heart.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue11: What matters is everyone made it out safe.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue12:
Thanks a lot. But I have to go now,
I’ve got work waiting.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue14:
I’m a bit ashamed of my behavior.
I’m sorry, Mister Leorio.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue15: Huh? What are you talking about?
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue16: No hard feelings! Just call me Leorio.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue17: I owe you an apology too...
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue18: For what I said about your family.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue20: Don’t worry about it. I forgive you.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue21: You know what... I actually like you three.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue23:
I'll take you to the port closest
to the Hunter Exam center.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue25: I told you. I’m the one handling that.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue26:
And I declare all three of you
qualified.
BateauPontSauvetage.Evnt.dialogue30: with hopes of becoming a Hunter.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue1: Thank you, Captain. I had a lot of fun!
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue2: You're welcome, kid. I had a good time too.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue3: That crossing... I won’t forget it anytime soon.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue4:
Now then... as a thank-you,
I’ll give you a friendly tip.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue6: See that mountain to the west?
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue7:
At the top, there's a big cedar
overlooking everything.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue9: That’s where you need to go.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue10:
A shortcut to the exam center.
Trust me.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue11:
A shortcut? Alright, thanks Captain!
I’ll find it.
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue12:
Thanks again. See you around,
maybe!
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue14:
You have nothing to worry about,
Ging...
DolePort.Evnt.dialogue15: Your son is brave and determined.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue1: Your story sounds a bit fishy.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue3: Take a look at this official letter.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue4:
It says the exam is somewhere
in Zaban.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue5:
The cedar's the other way.
You must have misunderstood.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue6:
No, I'm sure he mentioned
that cedar tree.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue7:
Hmpf... This letter isn't very helpful
either way.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue9:
Finding the place with so little info...
That’s part of the test too.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue10: A Hunter has to be resourceful.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue11:
I know that! Stop treating me
like an idiot!
Dole.Evnt.dialogue12:
I'm heading to the big cedar.
There has to be something there.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue13: Wait, Gon! Look at that bus!
Dole.Evnt.dialogue14:
It goes straight to Zaban.
We’ll be there in minutes.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue15:
That kid’s way too naïve...
Trusts just anyone.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue17: It’s not because of the captain.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue18: I just want to see what Gon will do.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue20:
If they can’t think for themselves,
too bad.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue21:
I’m taking the bus. Simple, fast,
efficient.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue23:
Buses? They never go to Zaban.
Only newbies believe that.
Dole.Evnt.dialogue24:
Every rookie gets fooled...
right on arrival.
Yoriban.Evnt.dialogue1:
Now’s not the time to go back
to Dole, Gon.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue1: Nice vibe! Pretty creepy here though...
Loden.Evnt.dialogue2:
Seriously... it’s empty.
Even the birds won’t stay.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue3:
What is this ghost village?
Nobody’s around!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue4:
Actually, I think there are
a lot of people here.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue11:
There are only two answers
for the quiz, thrilling!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue12:
If you made it here, you’re heading
for the Great Cedar, right?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue13:
There’s only one path.
To pass, answer my one question
correctly.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue14: Hold on! What kind of setup is this?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue15:
You have five seconds to answer.
One mistake, and you’re disqualified.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue16:
And you can’t take the Hunter Exam
this year.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue17:
Got it. Another pre-selection step
before the real thing.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue18:
Don’t worry, quizzes are my thing.
One question, right?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue19:
The answer is one or two, your choice.
Any other word = disqualified.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue20:
Wait, I don’t agree. One question
for the three of us?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue21: If he answers wrong, I’m out too?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue22:
Why would I mess up? You’re more likely
to get it wrong statistically.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue23: And what makes you think that?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue24:
No, it’s great! Only one of us needs
to know the right answer.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue27:
Hey guys! Planning to chat here
all day?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue29:
That kid followed us.
He’s been behind us since the port.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue31:
Yes, sorry. I overheard what the
captain said about the cedar.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue33:
This young man seems eager,
let him go first. We’ll see
what kind of question it is.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue36:
(Fools. If I go first, I can
set traps ahead.)
Loden.Evnt.dialogue38:
Your mother and lover are
kidnapped by bandits.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue39:
You can only save one:
-One, your mother.
-Two, your lover.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue41: Oh! This is absurd! Answer one!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue43:
Easy. You only have one mom.
You can always find another
girlfriend.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue47:
Easy. Just say what she wants
to hear to win.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue49:
Unfair! This is outrageous!
Why is one answer better
than the other?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue50:
Say what they want to hear?
This is totally arbitrary!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue51:
I’m talking to you! Deaf much?!
I refuse this farce!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue55:
Now that you’re here,
you must take the quiz.
Or be disqualified.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue56:
What?! That’s not a real quiz!
Your questions are subjective!
There’s no right answer!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue60:
(I think that cat-eyed kid
figured it out.)
Loden.Evnt.dialogue61:
From now on, no talking.
One wrong word = disqualified.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue62:
Didn’t you get it, Leorio?
It’s simple!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue65:
Listen carefully.
Bandits kidnapped your son and
daughter.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue66:
You can save only one:
-One, your son.
-Two, your daughter.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue69:
I'm gonna take her down.
That'll teach her to ask
sick questions.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue71:
How can I calm down
with that lunatic?!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue72:
You're not going to ruin
everything now that we have
the right answer.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue74:
We had the best possible
reaction. Keeping silent.
It was the only acceptable
answer.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue75:
Silence? What are you
talking about?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue76:
Yes, silence. You said it
yourself earlier. It's
impossible to find the right
answer! Impossible!
Loden.Evnt.dialogue77:
You solved the quiz.
There is no right answer.
Yet, only the proposed
choices were acceptable.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue78:
In that case, silence was
all that remained.
It was the only possible
choice.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue79:
And that guy? Why did he
succeed?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue80:
She never said he passed.
She only told him to leave.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue81:
I figure the path he took
doesn't lead to the Grand
Cedar at all.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue82:
No, you're right. Take this
road. It's the correct one.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue83:
You're just two hours away
from the top of the
mountain.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue84:
Two hours? And I was
already tired of walking?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue85:
Once you reach the Grand
Cedar, you'll find a cabin.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue86:
It's inhabited by a couple
of navigators. If they think
you're worthy, they'll tell
you how to reach the exam
center.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue87:
Madam, please excuse me.
I was very rude.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue88:
It's fine, forget it.
I enjoy this part of my job,
meeting passionate people
like you.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue89:
Keep it up and make sure
to become a great Hunter.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue91:
No matter how much I think
about it, I still don't know
what the right answer is.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue92:
Still stressing over the
quiz? You can stop now.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue94:
The quiz is over.
We answered correctly.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue95:
Yeah, I know it's done.
Still, imagine one day two
loved ones are really in
danger and you can only
save one...
Loden.Evnt.dialogue96:
What would you do?
How would you choose?
No matter what, the choice
would be unfair.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue97:
Who says that situation
won't happen? And when it
does, how will we decide?
Loden.Evnt.dialogue98:
(Exactly, kid, you've
understood everything.
That reflection is the true
point of this quiz.
Life won't go easy on you,
Loden.Evnt.dialogue99:
misfortune will strike and
you must start considering
the worst possible
outcomes now.
Loden.Evnt.dialogue99b:
Be ready, because one day
your paths will split.)
ForetCédre.Envt.dialogue1:
We need to get to the
Grand Cedar!
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue1:
Hmmm... fresh faces,
lost in the shifting branches.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue2:
They call me Cartemire.
Cartographer of this forest...
one of a kind.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue4:
The Cedar Forest is never
the same two days in a row.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue5:
That's why I'm the only one
who can chart its paths.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue6: And you sell that? A map?
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue7:
I sell what I observe.
What I tame.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue9:
Hehe... the shop is open.
Step right up.
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue10:
You again?
The forest fascinates you
as much as it confuses you...
FôretCèdre-Tente.Envt.dialogue11:
My shop is open.
My maps await you.
FôretCèdre-MaisonNavigateur.Envt.dialogu:
Yes, a raccoon-fox!
It can turn into a human!
Be careful, they're clever!

The man is down!
We need to treat him fast!

My wife! Help her!
Save her, please!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue1:
(Gon keeps up with the monster,
despite the trees and darkness!
He's incredible!)
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue3: Come and get her if you dare!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue4: No way! The raccoon-fox can talk!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue5:
Yes, they're amazing creatures!
Full of talents!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue6:
Good! If he can talk,
we can negotiate!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue7:
Hey! Get over here,
you silly raccoon-fox!
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue10:
We have to stop
taking such risks.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue13:
How do you feel?
Are you hurt anywhere?
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue14:
No, I’m fine. How’s my husband?
Will he be alright?
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue15:
Don't worry. Someone stayed
behind to help him.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue16:
Please, can you take me
to him right away?
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue17:
I recognize that tattoo.
You're not...
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue21:
And the man in the cabin,
how is he?
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue22:
He'll be fine.
No need to worry.
His wounds were minor.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue23:
I gave him something to relax.
He’ll be better after some rest.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue25:
How did you know?
That I wasn’t Leorio?
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue26:
Honestly, I didn’t know
until you changed.
I hit you thinking Leorio
broke his word.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue27:
He was supposed to stay
with the injured guy.
To guard him if you came back.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue28:
Instead, I saw him return,
hands in his pockets,
oblivious he left his post.
That’s why I hit him.
FôretCèdre-RunForet1.Envt.dialogue29:
Let’s get back to our talk.
I want to know your true identity.
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue2:
You're fast for a kid!
Didn’t think you’d catch me,
worm!
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue3:
Get ready! I’ll show you
what happens when you hit me!
You’ll pay for my revenge!
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue6:
You're not the same
raccoon-fox I chased.
Are you a friend of his?
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue7:
Wait! How do you know
I'm not the same one?
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue8:
Well... You don’t even
look alike! And your voice
is way higher than his!
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue10:
What? What did I say
that’s so funny?
FôretCèdre-Falaise.Envt.dialogue11:
Hey! Honey! Come here!
Oh! I’ve got something
hilarious to show you!
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue2:
Usually, humans can't
tell us apart.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue3:
Makes it even better
when it happens!
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue4:
You see the difference?
I don't.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue5:
Same here. They look
the same to me.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue6:
Easy! The one Kurapika and
I chased earlier is the husband.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue7:
Oh yeah? Not very helpful,
you know.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue8:
Let's introduce ourselves
properly. We are navigators.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue9:
We help with the preselection
for the Hunter Exam.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue12:
Wow! You all really
fooled us good!
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue13:
That's part of our role,
but not all of it.
We lead candidates to the
exact exam location.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue14:
It changes every year,
and competitors couldn’t
find it on their own.
We’re here to guide them.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue16:
Of course, we don't escort
all the candidates
who show up.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue17:
We first assess their skills.
Not everyone deserves to
sit the Hunter Exam.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue20:
Congratulations.
You needed only one clue.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue21:
You figured us out fast,
realizing we weren't
an actual couple.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue22:
All thanks to my fake tattoo
on the wrist.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue23:
In our region, it's worn
by women who take a
vow of celibacy.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue24:
I drew it to help you
see through us.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue25:
Mr. Kurapika, by recognizing
this mark,
you showed your knowledge.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue30:
You didn’t uncover our
ruse until we revealed it.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue31:
But you rushed to help me
and gave me proper care.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue32:
What I appreciated most
were your kind words
when I pretended to worry.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue33:
I just did my duty.
Let’s leave it at that.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue34:
Your kindness makes you
a great Hunter candidate.
Leorio, you passed.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue40:
Your agility and observation
skills far surpass
normal human limits.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue41:
You may take the exam
without worry.
You have passed.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue43:
Hang on tight, we're taking
you to the exam center.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue44:
Beneath the light of the moon,
the fate of three challengers shifts.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue45:
Guided by strange creatures,
they venture deeper into the unknown.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue46:
Their steps lead them to a place
no map could ever reveal.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue47: The true Hunter Exam cannot be found on a chart.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue48:
It begins where logic ends,
and willpower takes over.
FôretCèdre-Fin.Envt.dialogue49:
After several hours of travel,
we arrive in Zaban, a prosperous city
where the Hunter Exam begins.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue1:
Whoa, not a sound here!
The atmosphere is really strange...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue2:
These candidates have nothing in common
with the ones we've seen before.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue3:
They're professionals. Each of them
is the best in their field.
No doubt about it.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue5:
What's wrong with them?
They all seem nervous.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue6:
Here! This is your badge.
Take good care of it!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue9:
Pin it on your chest and
whatever happens, don't lose it!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue10:
You three, is this your
first attempt?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue11: How do you know we're new?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue12:
It's easy, I've got an eye for it!
This is my 35th time
attempting this exam.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue14: Impressive, huh? I'm a veteran here!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue15:
Honestly, that's nothing
to brag about.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue17:
If you have questions,
feel free to ask me anytime.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue19:
You're welcome,
my name is Tompa.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue20:
I'm Gon, and this is Leorio
and Kurapika.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue21:
Do you know if others have
taken the exam as many times
as you have?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue22:
That many? No, but some
come back every year.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue23:
That one over there is Todo,
a wrestler. No one can match
his strength.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue24:
Over there is Bourbon,
the snake charmer. He's ruthless,
better not upset him.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue25:
Then there's Bodoro,
a martial arts expert.
He's not young, but unmatched.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue26:
The three brothers: Amory,
Imory, and Umory. They're
a strong team, always ranked well.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue27:
Finally, Geretta the hunter.
His blowgun makes him
a fearsome opponent.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue28:
There are many others,
but those are the oldest.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue32:
Look, strange right?
Bit by bit, his body
disappears into confetti.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue33: I swear to you, there's no trick.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue35: If you ever bump into me...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue36:
No way...
That maniac is back.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue37: Do you know who that is?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue38:
No?! You mean he already
tried the exam before?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue39b:
Everyone thought he'd pass easily
last year...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue39c:
But he almost killed a judge
he didn’t like.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue40:
That guy's a psycho!
How can they let him try again?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue41:
It's simple, the exam rules
change every year.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue42:
So do the judges who create
the trials.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue43:
Even the devil could become a Hunter
if one judge finds him worthy.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue45:
Anyway, around here we all fear
Hisoka like the plague.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue47: It's best not to provoke that guy.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue48:
Oh hey, by the way,
I've got something for you.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue49: How about a toast to our meeting?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue50:
Awesome! Honestly,
I wouldn't say no!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue51:
Thanks, perfect timing,
I'm super thirsty!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue55:
(Did you see that? Tompa
found more newbies to mess with.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue56:
(Yeah, he's really good
at breaking them down.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue57:
(Classic Tompa.
He really deserves his reputation
as a newbie crusher.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue58:
(These drinks contain
an extremely strong laxative.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue59:
(If they still want to take the exam,
I hope they brought spare clothes.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue60:
Tompa! I think your juice
has gone bad!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue61: No way! I almost drank it!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue62:
Ahhh that's weird, huh?
I'm really sorry, guys!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue63:
(Impossible! This laxative
is supposed to be undetectable!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue64:
I sincerely apologize!
I don't know what happened!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue65:
It's nothing, Tompa.
No need to apologize.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue66:
You're not feeling sick,
are you?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue67:
No, I'm fine.
Thanks for the warning.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue68:
No problem. I'm used to eating
herbs and plants in the forest,
so my palate is well trained.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue69:
Oh really? That's amazing!
That must be handy...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue70:
(You little brat!
I can't believe I fell for you.)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue71:
Alright, I'll leave you now.
Sorry again, see you later!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue72: That veteran sure talks a lot.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue73:
This isn’t looking good...
What's with the newbies this year?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue74:
Same thing happened with him,
Hanzo the ninja...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue75:
When I approached him,
he looked so naive...
I thought it was a sure win.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue79:
I'm searching for an item.
Shuuuuuut!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue80:
It's a legendary scroll,
the scroll of the supreme ninja.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue81:
You have to be a Hunter to find it.
They say it's hidden in a place
normal people can't reach.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue82:
Anyway, good thing you're here.
I was really starting to get bored.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue84:
How about a toast
to our meeting?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue85:
Ninja rules are strict.
I can't accept food or drinks
offered by others.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue88:
(I should've known.
He really is weird...)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue89:
(But the worst one,
the one who gave me the most trouble,
was him... Nicholas)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue90:
Hi, it must have been hard
for you to get here.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue91:
Not at all, everything went
exactly as I predicted.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue92:
I found the exam location by compiling
and analyzing all previous years' data.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue93:
It was child's play. I was actually
disappointed it wasn’t harder...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue94:
I'm impressed! You must be
really smart.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue95: I'm Tompa, nice to meet you.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue96: Tompa, you say? There, I found you!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue97:
This is your 35th attempt.
Only one person has done more!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue98:
But for consecutive participations,
you're the undisputed champion!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue99: 30 in a row, that’s truly remarkable!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue100:
Stop it, you’ll make me blush!
Here, have a juice to celebrate!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue101:
That said, despite all these attempts,
you’ve never passed the actual exam.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue103:
Is it because you’re too focused
on your secret objective?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue104: You're Mr. Tompa, the newbie wrecker!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue106:
Don’t worry. Your secret
is safe with me.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue107:
I won't say a word, out of respect
for your record and experience.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue110:
(You little brat!
You’ll pay for this!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue111:
(When the time comes during the exam,
I won't let you off easy!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue113:
Got any juice left?
I’m super thirsty!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue114:
I don't know why, it's strange...
Maybe it's just nerves?
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue116:
(That brat again!
After everything he drank...)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue117:
(The laxative should have worked
by now! How is this possible?!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue119:
(But with the amount he drank,
it might be dangerous...)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue122:
Don’t worry about me.
I'm well trained!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue124:
(Did he figure it out?
Did he know about the juice?)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue125:
(And he drank it anyway?!
Killua... The newbies
are tough this year!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue126:
(Getting rid of him
isn’t going to be easy...)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue127:
(Then again, it adds some spice.
At least I won’t be bored!)
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue128:
I sincerely apologize
for the long wait.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue129:
The candidate preselections
are now complete.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue130:
I hereby declare the Hunter Exam
officially open!
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue131:
One last warning: if luck leaves you,
or you're not good enough...
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue132:
You might be seriously injured
or worse, lose your life.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue133:
If you understand and accept the risk,
please follow me now.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue134:
The rest of you are asked
to exit quietly.
EgoutDépart.Envt.dialogue135:
Very well, let’s go.
All participants proceed
to the first trial.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue1:
It was obvious... no one would give up
so close to the goal.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue2: Too bad, I was hoping for a few dropouts.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue3:
Looks like the front runners
have started running.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue3b:
The man we're following
has picked up the pace!
Egout1.Envt.dialogue4:
I forgot to introduce myself.
My name is Satotz.
I'm the judge for the first trial
of the exam.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue5:
I'm taking you to the place
where the second trial will be held.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue6:
The second one?
So what's the first trial then?
Egout1.Envt.dialogue8:
The instruction is simple:
You must follow me to the end.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue9:
That’s all there is to
the first trial.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue10:
We just have to follow you?
That’s really all?
Egout1.Envt.dialogue11:
Yes. But I can’t tell you
where we're going or
how long it will take.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue12:
You just have to keep
running behind me.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue15:
He probably wants to test
our obedience and stamina.
Egout1.Envt.dialogue16:
Fine by me!
If he thinks he can outrun me,
he's dreaming!
Egout1.Envt.dialogue17:
(It won't be that easy.
Running without knowing when
it ends isn't about strength.)
Egout3.Envt.dialogue1:
(Based on my data,
this type of exam usually
includes a run of about 40 km.)
Egout3.Envt.dialogue2:
(According to my calculations,
we should reach the goal
in less than 30 kilometers.)
Egout3.Envt.dialogue4:
(Looks like I underestimated
the difficulty of the Hunter Exam.)
Egout3.Envt.dialogue5:
(All these guys are
built like tanks...)
Egout3.Envt.dialogue6:
Hey brat! That's disgraceful!
You shame the Hunter Exam!
Aren't you ashamed?!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue8:
Don’t play dumb!
That skateboard of yours is cheating!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue10:
Because it’s a test
of endurance!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue12: Huh?! Gon, what are you saying?
Egout3.Envt.dialogue13:
The judge told us to follow him,
but he never said how!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue14: Oh really?! Whose side are you on?!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue18:
Alright then, I think
I'll start running!
Egout3.Envt.dialogue22:
(Now I’m getting outrun
by kids... Unbelievable.)
Egout7.Envt.dialogue3:
I never make mistakes
in my calculations!
Egout7.Envt.dialogue4:
Then why haven't we
arrived yet?
Egout7.Envt.dialogue5:
If this keeps up,
I'm going to fail...
Egout7.Envt.dialogue9:
It's rare to see someone
get tired this quickly
in the race.
Egout7.Envt.dialogue11:
For guys like you,
the Hunter Exam is lost
from the start!
Egout7.Envt.dialogue12:
And don’t even think about
coming back, loser!
Egout7.Envt.dialogue14:
Here! Your money!
You nailed it!
Egout7.Envt.dialogue16:
(After the way we tore him down,
it'll take him a while
to recover.)
Egout8.Envt.dialogue1:
(We've been running
for four hours now...)
Egout8.Envt.dialogue2:
(We must have done 60 km.
How much longer
are we going to run like this?)
Egout8.Envt.dialogue3:
(They say only one candidate
passes the exam
every three years.)
Egout8.Envt.dialogue4: Well, it’s not gonna be me!
Egout8.Envt.dialogue5:
(Unfortunately, for an ordinary guy
like me, this is hopeless.)
Egout8.Envt.dialogue6: Let him handle it on his own.
Egout8.Envt.dialogue9: I have to become a Hunter!
Egout8.Envt.dialogue10: Wanna race to keep it fun?
Egout8.Envt.dialogue11: First one to the end wins!
Egout8.Envt.dialogue12: Deal! Loser buys the winner lunch!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue3: I figured out what to do!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue4:
Just charge ahead without
overthinking it!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue6:
Leorio, if I may, I'd like
to ask you something.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue7:
Seriously? You got energy to spare?
Is this too easy for you?!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue8:
I don't want to waste energy
on chit-chat.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue9:
Do you want to become a Hunter
just for the money?
Egout9.Envt.dialogue13:
I’ve only known you a few days,
but I can tell you're better than that!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue14:
Okay, sure, you're stubborn
and not very bright...
Egout9.Envt.dialogue15:
But I know how to spot someone
who's not shallow!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue16:
I've met plenty of people
who only care about money...
Egout9.Envt.dialogue17:
And I can tell you're
not like them!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue19b:
That’s why my clan
was massacred!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue20:
The Kurta clan was known
for that unique trait.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue21:
When we feel intense emotions,
our eyes turn scarlet.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue23:
That fiery glow is considered
one of the seven most beautiful colors
in the world.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue24:
Scarlet eyes fetch a fortune
on the black market.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue25:
So that’s why the Phantom Troupe
attacked your clan?!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue26:
They stole the eyes of
all my brothers.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue27:
I still see their empty sockets
and lifeless bodies...
Egout9.Envt.dialogue28:
I hear them cry for revenge!
And it's up to me to punish
the ones responsible!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue29:
I'll find every last member
of the Phantom Troupe.
I swear it!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue30:
So that's why you want
to become a Hunter?
Egout9.Envt.dialogue31:
Yes. If I can work for wealthy clients,
I'll gain access to tons of
black market info.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue32:
I see... But you realize
you'll have to swallow your pride
and become one of those mercenaries
you've always despised?
Egout9.Envt.dialogue34:
I'm ready to do anything
to avenge my clan!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue35:
Sorry... But I'm not doing this
for a noble cause like you.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue36:
I care about money!
That’s it!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue39:
Really? So you honestly believe
money can buy everything
in this world?
Egout9.Envt.dialogue40: Oh yes! Everything can be bought!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue41:
Things, dreams, hearts, even
people’s lives!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue43:
If you insult my clan,
I'll never forgive you!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue45:
If I had money back then,
my friend wouldn’t have died!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue47: Do you want to talk about it?
Egout9.Envt.dialogue48:
His illness wasn’t incurable.
The problem was the surgery
cost a fortune!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue49:
I was naive. I thought
I could become a surgeon
and save kids like him.
Egout9.Envt.dialogue50:
I'd tell the families the good news,
and treat them for free!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue51:
That way, he wouldn't have
died for nothing!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue52:
That was my dream,
my goal!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue54:
You’d better be rich
if you want to become a surgeon!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue55:
See? Money! Money! Money!
That’s all that matters!
Egout9.Envt.dialogue56: So I play the game too!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue1:
Gon, you're able to run
as fast as me! You're pretty good!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue3:
Or maybe the others
are just really slow...
Egout10.Envt.dialogue4:
Seriously... This is the Hunter Exam?
It's way too easy!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue5: And here I thought I'd have some fun...
Egout10.Envt.dialogue6:
By the way, Killua, why do you want
to become a Hunter?
Egout10.Envt.dialogue7:
To be honest, I don't really want
to become one.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue8:
I heard the exam was super tough,
so I thought it might be fun.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue10b: Because my father is a Hunter!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue10aa:
For Aunt Mito! She wants me to
find my father, who's a Hunter!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue10bb:
I'm doing it because my father
is a Hunter! So I wanted to
become one like him!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue10cc:
To earn money! So I can find
my father, who's a Hunter!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue11: What kind of Hunter is your father?
Egout10.Envt.dialogue15:
Well, you say you want to be like him,
but you don’t seem to know much
about your dad.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue16:
That’s true. It’s because Mito’s the one
who raised me since I was little.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue17: I've only seen my dad in a photo.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue18:
He took the Hunter Exam at 12,
just like me!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue19:
He left our island to become a Hunter,
and passed every trial!
Egout10.Envt.dialogue20:
I want to understand why he chose
being a Hunter over staying with me.
Egout10.Envt.dialogue21:
(Alright, we've reached the exit.
Let's see how many made it this far.)
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue1:
Awesome!
I'm the one who won!
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue2:
What are you talking about?
I was the one who won!
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue5:
You're dreaming!
I crossed the finish line first!
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue9: No way, I clearly arrived first!
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue11:
Seems to me you both
arrived at the same time.
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue12:
Alright, in that case,
I'll treat you to a meal.
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue14:
Next time, it's your turn
to pay for us both!
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue16:
Mr. Satotz, have we reached
the second trial of the exam?
SortieEgout1.Envt.dialogue17:
Not yet. The road
is still long.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue4:
Also known as the
'Nest of Swindlers'.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue5:
You'll have to cross this swamp
to reach the site
of the second trial.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue6:
This forest is home to many
strange animals.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue7:
Many of them are fierce
and insatiable creatures.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue8:
They’ll deceive humans
just to eat them.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue9:
One wrong step,
and they'll kill you.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue10:
The animals living here
will use every possible trick
to fool their prey.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue11:
In this ecosystem, they survive
through lies and deception.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue12:
That's why it's called
the 'Nest of Swindlers'.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue13:
If you value your life,
stay alert and keep your eyes on me.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue14:
Ahhh... this is so dumb!
How could they trick us
if we already know?
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue16:
Okay, we get it!
No need to get mad...
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue18:
He’s lying!
That guy is an impostor!
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue20:
I'm the real judge
of this trial!
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue24: Whoa! He looks just like Satotz!
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue26:
One of the creatures
that lives in this swamp.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue27:
They are ruthless,
they love human flesh.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue28:
But their frail and weak bodies
make them powerless.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue29:
So they take on a human appearance
to lure people into
the heart of the swamp.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue30:
Then they team up with other beasts
to hunt and kill them.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue31:
And that one planned to catch
all the candidates and eliminate
them one by one!
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue33:
Makes sense, to be honest.
The way he runs isn't human at all.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue35: Well, now we know for sure.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue36:
No more doubt about it,
you're the real judge!
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue39:
They volunteer for this mission
at the request of the exam committee.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue40:
They’ve all passed the trials themselves,
and most are formidable.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue41:
Which means any Hunter
would have blocked my attack.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue42:
I'll take your comments
as a compliment.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue43:
But if you attack me again,
for any reason...
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue44:
I’ll have to report it
to my superiors, and you'll be
immediately disqualified.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue47: So that one was a Monkey-Man too?
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue48:
Yes, and he tried to confuse you
with a bunch of lies.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue49:
He was probably hoping you'd follow him
back to his lair.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue50:
You'll face situations like this
more than once during the exam.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue51:
I'm sure some of you almost believed
I wasn’t the real judge.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue54:
Be careful. We're about to enter
the Numél swamp, where many
dangers await you.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue55:
If you lose sight of me
in the fog, you’ll never reach
the second trial.
SortieEgout2.Envt.dialogue57:
Let’s go! No time to waste,
we’ve got a long road ahead!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue1:
Be very careful!
Above all, don't stray from me!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue2:
I can't believe it...
The fog is getting thicker!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue4:
Let's take advantage of the fog
to settle the score with him.
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue5: Gon, let's get closer to the judge.
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue6:
Yeah, you're right.
We better not lose sight of him
in a place like this!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue7:
Mostly, I’d rather stay away
from Hisoka.
It’s a safety issue!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue8: It's not safe to stay near him.
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue12: I don't smell anything in particular.
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue14:
Killua says we should move
to the front of the group,
close to the judge.
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue15:
You don’t have to shout it
to the world...
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue16:
What do you think!
If we had the strength,
we’d be there already!
MarécageNuméelIntro.Envt.dialogue17:
Don't worry about us,
go ahead!
GonKillua.Envt.dialogue1:
You hear that, Killua?
Screams from every direction!
GonKillua.Envt.dialogue3:
Leorio and Kurapika...
I hope they're alright.
GonKillua.Envt.dialogue6:
If we hurry, we can still
catch up to the judge.
KurapikaLeolioMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue2: We can't see the group anymore.
KurapikaLeolioMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue3:
That’s not good...
How do we know where to go now?
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue1:
The moment I saw you
last year...
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue2:
I knew you didn’t have what it takes
to become a Hunter.
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue3:
If you promise not to
try again, we'll let you go.
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue6:
Since I’ll pass the exam this year,
I won’t try again.
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue9:
With this thick fog, none of us
can tell where the others went.
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue10:
Which means we all failed.
You and us—we're done with this exam!
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue12:
Since you failed, you decided
to play the judge.
IntroCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue15:
Given your skills,
I’m the only one fit to judge.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue6: Willing to play the judge’s game?
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue8:
When I give the signal,
we run in opposite directions.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue10:
He's got more real combat
experience than us.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue11:
Even together, we stand no chance
against him!
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue13:
Then let’s not waste time
with a fight we’ll lose.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue19:
Even if this has nothing
to do with me...
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue20:
I can't just walk away
as if I saw nothing...
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue21: That's just not who I am.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue28:
Is that a fishing rod
you’ve got there?
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue30:
Can I have a look at it?
Please?
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue33: You came to save your friend?
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue45:
I don’t plan to kill
your friend.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue49: Grow up and become a great Hunter.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue51:
We’re approaching the second
trial site.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue52: Got it. I’ll be right there.
FinCombatHisoka.Envt.dialogue54:
Will you be alright?
Can you find your way back?
ChateauForetViscaEntre.Envt.dialogue1: Oh no, I can’t believe this...
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue2:
Are you sure that's
the path he took?
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue3: Yes, Leorio wears a special scent.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue4:
I can’t be mistaken.
I can smell it from miles away
without any trouble.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue6:
What did Hisoka mean when he said
we had passed the test?
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue7:
I don’t know, but maybe
he was evaluating us like a judge.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue9:
Yes, he must have his own standards
to assess someone's strength.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue10:
Wouldn’t be surprised if he
tested everyone to gauge their power.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue11:
If he told you that,
it means you and Leorio
met his expectations.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue12:
Yeah, I see...
But I couldn’t do anything
against him...
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue14:
Still, you managed to hit him
before he came at you.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue15: Yeah, but that was by surprise.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue16: It’s odd. Leorio passed his test.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue17:
Even though he was beaten
so easily.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue19:
Maybe he felt like you two
shared something in common.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue21:
Honestly, I don’t think Hisoka
is fit to become a Hunter.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue22:
That said, his skill
is undeniably impressive.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue23: His technique takes your breath away.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue24:
People with rare talents often
recognize others who have the same.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue25:
Maybe Hisoka, with his instinct
and experience, felt you and Leorio
had the potential to become Hunters.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue26: Would’ve been a waste to kill you now.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue27:
That's one way to see it
from his perspective.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue29: What I said must’ve shocked you.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue31: In front of him, I felt excited.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue32:
I was so scared I wanted to run,
but I couldn’t move.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue33:
And at the same time,
I was fascinated.
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue35: For the first time in his life...
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue37:
Yet even if he’s shaken
by this new emotion...
GonKurapikaMarecageFin.Envt.dialogue38:
Gon can’t suppress
his growing curiosity.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue1:
Fights are real-time,
with an ATB system!
Fight.Presentation.dialogue2:
Each character has a gauge
that fills automatically.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue3:
When full, they can take
action immediately.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue4:
Choose:
- "Attack" for a quick strike
- "Defend" to guard
- "Item" to use an item
- "Flee" to escape
Fight.Presentation.dialogue5:
Basic attacks deal damage
based on character strength.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue6:
Guard reduces damage
for a few turns.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue7:
At the end of each turn,
Guard level drops,
but may stay up longer.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue8:
Use it wisely to survive
big attacks!
Fight.Presentation.dialogue9:
Some items can be used
in battle, like onigiri
for healing.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue10:
You can try fleeing if it’s
not a mandatory fight.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue11:
Each failed attempt raises
your escape chance.
Fight.Presentation.dialogue12:
Watch the gauges,
plan carefully... and win!
actors.gon.profile:
A curious and determined boy,
raised on Whale Island.
He sets off to find his father.
